أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار
إبراهيم بن محمد بن عبد الله

notes: two sayings: the birth account by Nasim and Mariya (saying 1, the Imam speaks inside it with the sneeze and «الحمد لله»), and the sneeze saying that «إبراهيم بن محمد» gives on Nasim's word (saying 2, rule 4a)
the second group writes Ibrahim again and «نسيم» with occurrence 2 (the «حدثتني نسيم خادم أبي محمد» line); the Imam is last in both (owner ruling 5)
«أبي محمد» in the second group is the Imam's father's kunya in Nasim's description; it is not a link
